records.title: test(vscode): move multi-root end-to-end coverage into the live suite
records.release_claim: the multi-root and Workspace Trust acceptance tests actually execute in the protected VS Code lane
records.reason: Dead tests are not proof. This moves the claimed coverage under the live runner and removes the duplicate inert harness, making it a prerequisite for source #1507 rather than shipped runtime semantics.
records.non_claim: A live test suite does not itself prove the packaged VSIX candidate or every editor client.
